title: TrackerIgnoreExpiryRepository
responsibility: Read ignored items that have an end and commit each planned restore after re-reading the row under the journal writer lock.

inputs.name: TrackerIgnoreExpiryRepository.constructor.store
inputs.description: Journal holding the Tracker items and their operations.

inputs.name: TrackerIgnoreExpiryRepository.restore.plan
inputs.description: Returns the fields to write when an ignore has ended, otherwise undefined.

outputs.name: TrackerIgnoreExpiryRepository.restore
outputs.description: Completes after every ended ignore has been written to the journal.
